text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after our little outing, Mayano
Top Gun trained to the best
of her
abilities,
trying hard to not get too bored.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Phew... that's the last one!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... Not yet.
I can still run! What's up
next?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I still think training's boring,
and I really
don't see the point of it,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I told myself that I'd listen to you—
that I'd
try really hard if you told
me to! So tell
me, what do I do next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The training regimen I prepared for
Mayano is meant to improve her
stamina.
To my surprise, she really listened to all
my instructions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This went on for a few days...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You won't believe this! C'mon, follow me!
This way, now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Guess what! I get to run in a scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
They told me that since I've been training
so hard, I can run in a race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yep! All thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, come and watch me race, okay? I'm gonna head over first to get ready, but I'll be waiting for you! You have to come! Promise?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I agree and promise her that I will attend
the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems all pumped up and ready to go.
I wonder how she'll run
today...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey Brian! Are you here to run in the scrimmage too?! You're running with me?! Yesss!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What's with you? Why are you so...
annoying?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm just so happy! ♪ ...Oh, you
came!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep! ♪ I feel on top of the world right
now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to put into words,
but I feel like
I'm gonna have so much fun
today! I
wonder why...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This will be my first time watching Mayano
race since she started
training seriously.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A runner of pure natural talent, she
possesses an incredible intuition
and
knows how to make the best decisions in a
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's combined that talent with
some solid training, who
knows what
heights she can achieve?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it looks like they're starting soon! I
gotta go, but don't take your
eyes off me,
okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race has just started,
and Narita Brian
is already setting the pace
with her
commanding  presence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Partway through, in an attempt to block
off Narita Brian, Mayano Top Gun tries to
maneuver her way in front of the
experienced
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay, now's my chance! I go whip here, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Out of my way.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But I thought I got it! How come
that didn't work?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tables turn, and it's Mayano Top Gun
who ends up being
blocked. She then
begins to fall behind...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Narita Brian isn't a racer to
be underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said,
Mayano also isn't the type to go
down without a fight.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(I have this... weird feeling.
I thought I got
it, but it didn't work out.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(But... I dunno...
I feel like I still get it. I
get it, but it's something new
that I'm
getting.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(I mean,
my legs are still moving! So I have
to get it more! I have to
do more!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun sets her eyes on Narita
Brian's back, and with a sudden burst of
speed, she dashes ahead through the
crowd of
runners.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya, taking off!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah... this one's good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Mayano was unable to
overtake Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But her efforts are praiseworthy
nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... sigh... I can't believe I lost!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but... it was amazing! I had sooo
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I mean, this is the first time I've ever
figured out something new in the
middle
of a race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But I still couldn't catch up to Brian...
and
then I noticed even more
stuff I don't get.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That made it way more exciting though! It
was fun before, but it's
even more so now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you think that maybe... just
maybe... this is 'cause I trained?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Training... lets me get new things. That's
the point, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It's boring, and I don't like it,
but I
guess it isn't pointless.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okay,
I'll keep doing it! But only with you.
I'll power through the
boredom, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So could you, um... y'know... could you
stay with me?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll become a twinkly grown-up racer too,
just you wait and see! I
wanna show you
before I show anybody else!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Really?! Are you for real?! No
backsies, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days training Mayano
Top Gun, a young genius
hiding infinite
potential within her small frame.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll remember you.
